subject: Next steps: DPA request, SCC module preference, and SOC 2 / VSQ follow-up
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.m@novapay.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 15:04:00 +0000
Subject: Post-call: DPA ask, SCC module, SOC 2 evidence + VSQ initiation

Hi Elena — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum: 

Summary of your asks from today
- DPA: NovaPay prefers a DPA that references the appropriate SCC module for controller-to-processor relationships.
- SCC module: preliminary preference is Module 2 (Controller -> Processor) per your legal team guidance.
- SOC 2: you requested our latest SOC 2 Type II report (redacted copy is fine).
- Vendor security questionnaire (VSQ): you flagged a 30-question intake — happy to start that.

Our immediate plan
1) I can send a Redwood DPA template and supply a redacted SOC 2 Type II PDF (we host the latest report internally).
2) Marissa (cc'd) will own legal intake and can review any redlines on the DPA.
3) Ben (cc'd) will pull and share the subprocessor list and retention defaults.
4) If NovaPay can drop the VSQ file in the Drive link below or attach it, we'll begin filling it and aim to return a complete response within 5 business days.

Deliverables I will attach in the next email: Redwood_DPA_v1.1.docx, Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025_redacted.pdf, current subprocessor list (summary).

Can you confirm Module 2 is what legal expects? Also, are there any specific retention windows or deletion confirmations you need spelled out in the DPA?

Drive link for VSQ upload: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cVSQ
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/78910

Thanks — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: Redwood_DPA_v1.1.docx (will follow), Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025_redacted.pdf (will follow)
From: Elena Morales <elena.m@novapay.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Gupta <sgupta@novapay.com>, NovaPay Legal <legal@novapay.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 11:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call: DPA ask, SCC module, SOC 2 evidence + VSQ initiation

Hi Vivek — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming a few points from our side: 

1) SCC module: Yes — our legal team indicated Module 2 (Controller -> Processor) is the baseline for this engagement. We will share any narrow exceptions separately.
2) DPA redlines: we will start from your DPA template but expect to propose a couple of modest edits around logging retention and incident notification windows.
3) SOC 2: please provide the latest SOC 2 Type II (redacted) PDF. We will only need the high-level report and the auditor letter.
4) VSQ: attaching the vendor intake spreadsheet (NovaPay_VSQ.xlsx) — please populate the fields you can and note where you will provide evidence links.

A couple of asks for clarity before you prepare the DPA: 
- Are you able to confirm primary data flow (customer PII -> Redwood model runtime) and whether Redwood persists raw payloads beyond 30 days by default?
- Do you maintain a subprocessors list and last updated timestamp?

I attached the VSQ. Our target timeline is to get the completed VSQ and DPA back to legal review within 7 business days if possible.

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Compliance | NovaPay
Attachment: NovaPay_VSQ.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.m@novapay.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 09:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: DPA ask, SCC module, SOC 2 evidence + VSQ initiation

Hi Elena — copying next steps from Redwood legal/ops side.

What we will provide (this week)
- Redwood_DPA_v1.1.docx (our standard DPA with Module 2 annex language). We will populate the standard clauses and flag the sections we commonly see redlined (retention, breach notice windows, and liability caps).
- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025_redacted.pdf (redacted auditor report and management assertion).
- Subprocessor summary (vendor names + function + link to more detail). Ben will attach a one-pager.
- Preliminary answers to the VSQ (we'll fill the spreadsheet and point to evidence).

Answers to your questions now:
- Data flows: Redwood acts as a processor for customer-provided inputs. By default we retain request/response logs for 30 days for debugging and performance analytics; you can request shorter retention in the DPA (we will add the configurable retention clause).
- Subprocessors: yes — we maintain a list and last updated timestamp. Ben will include the current list and the last updated date.

Proposed timeline
- Oct 16: We upload DPA template and redacted SOC 2 report to the shared Drive.
- Oct 18: Redwood returns the completed VSQ with evidence links.
- Oct 20: Target for NovaPay legal to review and provide initial redlines (if any).

If that timeline looks tight for your team, let us know and we'll extend accordingly.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Contracts Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_v1.1.docx, Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025_redacted.pdf (uploaded to Drive)

Thanks Elena — appreciate the quick confirmation. We uploaded the deliverables to the Drive and attached the key files to this thread for convenience: Redwood_DPA_v1.1.docx, Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025_redacted.pdf, and a short subprocessor summary. Ben — please confirm the subprocessor list has the Oct 15 last-updated stamp before we share.

Next steps (owners)
- Marissa: upload DPA and SOC2 to Drive and notify NovaPay legal (done).
- Ben: finalize subprocessor list & last-updated date and attach.
- Vivek: follow up on VSQ completion on Oct 18 and coordinate any technical evidence links (logs, config screenshots).

I'll schedule a 30-minute follow-up call for Oct 21 to walk through any DPA redlines if that works for your legal team — or we can handle via HubSpot thread if faster.

Cheers,
Vivek
